//@version=5
indicator("uct-hma-macd-parity-v1", overlay=false)
hma20 = ta.hma(close, 20)
[macdLine, signalLine, histLine] = ta.macd(close, 12, 26, 9)
plot(hma20, title="hma20")
plot(macdLine, title="macdLine")
plot(signalLine, title="signalLine")
plot(histLine, title="histLine")

provenance.note: Captured via CSV export (Table view -> Download data) of a real SPY Daily chart with a live ta.hma(close,20)/ta.macd(close,12,26,9) indicator added, full double-precision floats. 2,031 real trading-day bars (2018-08-07..2026-09-04). HMA composes ONLY wma (near-window WMA(n/2), full-window WMA(n), 2*near-full, then a final WMA over sqrt(n)) -- a memoryless, finite-impulse construction with no recursive/leaky state, so unlike ema/rma it was expected, and confirmed empirically (see report), to carry NO capture-window seed-convergence lag beyond its own true period-warmup -- the same structural finding already made for sma/wma.

_vendor_parity_warmup_bars_note: 22 IS the true, full semantic period-warmup for hma(close,20) -- derived structurally (half=10 -> WMA(n=20) needs index>=19; the final WMA over root=4 raw values needs index>=19+4-1=22) and confirmed empirically: 0 disagreements found among all 2,009 real bars this capture holds from index 22 onward (last_bad_index=-1, i.e. NONE), the same zero-additional-margin result already found for sma/wma. No capture-window seed-convergence-lag margin is needed.
